content.short: An endless runner game with NFT's on Cardano.
content.description:
Everybody loves The Bull Run! Press some buttons, outperform others, and hopefully make some money. Get yourself a Bull and make a run for the top of the all-time leaderboard, or finish in the top 3 on the weekly leaderboard to win various prices including CNFT's or some ADA!

The Bull Run features 10000 unique bulls as Non-Fungible Tokens that can be used as characters in our endless runner game.
